blocks.text: Maddi ajsaam (material bodies) ki sab harkaton mein dairawi harkat (circular motion) qudrat mein sab se zyada nazar aati hai. Zameen ke gird dairawi orbits mein ghoomte satellites, khud Zameen ki orbital aur spin (apne mehwar par ghoomne ki) harkat, mor par murti car, aur dori se ghumaya gaya patthar iski aam misalein hain. Jab cheezein daire mein chalti hain to un ki direction (simt) lagatar badalti rehti hai. Velocity vector quantity hai, is liye direction badalne ka matlab hai ke velocity constant nahi rehti.
Is chapter mein hum circular motion, rotational motion (gardishi harkat), moment of inertia, angular momentum aur in se mutalliq topics parhenge.

Daire ke markaz (centre) O par arc (qaus) AB se banne wala angle lein (Fig. 3.1). Agar arc AB ki lambai daire ke radius r ke barabar ho to markaz par banne wala angle ek radian kehlata hai. Radian angle napne ka SI unit hai aur is ka symbol “rad” hai.

blocks.alt: Markaz O wala daira. Do radius OA aur OB, dono par r likha hai, ek rangeen qitaa (sector) gherte hain; qaus (arc) AB ki lambai radius ke barabar hai aur O par zawiya 1 rad likha hai. Daire ke bahar mura teer A se B ki taraf jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.1: Ek radian: markaz O par woh zawiya jo radius r ke barabar arc AB banata hai (kitab ki Figure 3.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Angular Displacement

Mass m ka ek particle P lein jo radius r ke daire mein chal raha hai. Farz karein P lambai r ki ek be-wazan (massless) sakht chhari (rigid rod) ke sire par laga hai, aur chhari ka doosra sira daire ke markaz O par pivot hai (Fig. 3.2a). Jab particle daire par chalta hai to chhari OP daire ki satah (plane) mein ghoomti hai. Gardish ka axis (axis of rotation) pivot O se guzarta hai aur gardish ki satah par amood (perpendicular) hai. Axes Fig. 3.2(b) ki tarah lein: z-axis gardish ke axis ke saath, O origin par; x aur y axes gardish ki satah mein. Kisi waqt t par OP ki jagah OP₁ hai jo x-axis se angle θ banati hai. Thore baad waqt t + Δt par yeh OP₂ hai jo x-axis se angle θ + Δθ banati hai (Fig. 3.2c).

blocks.alt: Markaz O wala daira. Lambai r ki chhari O ko daire par zarre P se jorti hai; P ke qareeb bahar teer dikhata hai ke P ghari ki sui ke ulat (anticlockwise) chal raha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2(a): Lambai r ki chhari OP ke sire par daire mein chalta zarra P (kitab ki Figure 3.2(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Gardish ka daira perspective mein bayzawi (ellipse) dikhaya gaya hai, markaz O. O se dashed axes: z seedha oopar gardish ke axis ke saath, y daen taraf aur x dekhne wale ki taraf. Lambai r ki chhari OP daire par zarre P tak jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2(b): Gardish ke axes: z gardish ke axis ke saath O se, x aur y gardish ki satah mein (kitab ki Figure 3.2(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Markaz O wala daira, daen taraf dashed x-axis aur oopar dashed y-axis. O se lambai r ke do teer: OP₁ x-axis se zawiya θ par aur OP₂ thora aage, θ + Δθ par. Dono ke darmiyan chhota zawiya Δθ hai, aur daire par chhota teer P₁ se P₂ tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2(c): Waqt t par OP₁ zawiya θ par aur Δt baad OP₂ zawiya θ + Δθ par (kitab ki Figure 3.2(c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Angle Δθ waqt Δt mein OP ki angular displacement hai. Bohat chhoti Δθ ke liye angular displacement vector quantity hai.
blocks.title: Angular displacement

blocks.text: Agar OP counter clockwise (ghari ki sui ke ulat) ghoome to Δθ ko positive (musbat) maana jata hai.
Δθ ki direction gardish ke axis ke saath hoti hai aur right hand rule se maloom hoti hai (Fig. 3.2d):
Gardish ke axis ko daayen haath mein yun pakrein ke ungliyan gardish ki direction mein mudi hon; angootha angular displacement ki direction batata hai.
blocks.title: Right hand rule

blocks.alt: Amoodi (vertical) gardishi axis ek ufuqi daire ke markaz O se guzarta hai; daira bayzawi dikhaya gaya hai. Chhari OP oopar se dekhne par anticlockwise ghoomti hai, P ke paas teer yeh dikhata hai. Daire ke oopar daayan haath axis ko pakarta hai: ungliyan gardish ki simt mein mudi aur angutha axis ke saath oopar.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2(d): Angular displacement ki simt ke liye right-hand rule (kitab ki Figure 3.2(d) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yahan OP upar se dekhne par anticlockwise ghoom raha hai, is liye ungliyan anticlockwise mudti hain aur angootha upar ki taraf hai: angular displacement (aur angular velocity) upar axis ke saath hai. Gardish clockwise hoti to angootha neeche hota.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Angular displacement teen units mein likhi jati hai: degree, revolution aur radian. Radius r ke daire ka lambai S wala arc lein jo markaz par angle θ banata hai (Fig. 3.3). Radian mein:

blocks.alt: Markaz O wala daira, ufuqi radius OP = r. Doosra radius OP₁, OP se zawiya θ banata hai. P se P₁ tak ki qaus gehri dikhai gayi hai aur us par S likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.3: Radius r ke daire ki lambai S wali qaus PP₁ markaz O par zawiya θ banati hai (kitab ki Figure 3.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Agar OP ek poora chakkar (revolution) lagaye to nuqta P daire ka poora gher S = 2πr tay karta hai. Radian mein yeh hai:
Angular Velocity

Aksar hum jaanna chahte hain ke koi cheez kitni tez ya aahista ghoom rahi hai. Yeh angular velocity se pata chalta hai: angular displacement ke waqt ke saath badalne ki rate. Fig. 3.2(c) mein agar waqt Δt mein angular displacement Δθ ho to is waqt mein average angular velocity:
Instantaneous (lamhati) angular velocity ω, Δθ/Δt ki woh qeemat hai jab Δt zero ke qareeb pohanch jaye:

Jab Δt zero ke qareeb ho to angular displacement bohat hi chhoti hoti hai, is liye woh vector hai, aur Eq. 3.3 wali angular velocity bhi vector hai. Is ki direction gardish ke axis ke saath hai aur right hand rule se milti hai.
Angular velocity ka SI unit radian per second (rad s⁻¹) hai. Kabhi kabhi ise revolution per minute (rpm) mein bhi likhte hain.
blocks.title: Angular velocity ka unit

blocks.text: Angular acceleration

Bijli ka pankha (fan) chalayein to us ki angular velocity barhti jati hai; yani us mein angular acceleration hai. Angular acceleration angular velocity ke badalne ki rate hai. Agar waqt tᵢ par angular velocity ωᵢ aur waqt t_f par ω_f ho to waqt t_f − tᵢ mein average angular acceleration:
Instantaneous angular acceleration α, Δω/Δt ki woh qeemat hai jab Δt zero ke qareeb ho:
Angular acceleration bhi vector hai: is ki miqdar (magnitude) Eq. 3.5 se milti hai aur direction gardish ke axis ke saath hoti hai. Is ka unit rad s⁻² hai.

Ab tak hum ne be-wazan chhari ke sire par laga ek particle P dekha. Ab ek rigid body (sakht jism) ki gardish lein (Fig. 3.4). Jism par ek nuqta P sochein; P se gardish ke axis par jo perpendicular line OP girti hai use reference line kehte hain. Jab jism ghoomta hai to OP bhi usi angular velocity aur angular acceleration se ghoomti hai. Is liye poore rigid body ki gardish ko us ki reference line OP ki gardish se bayan kiya ja sakta hai, aur OP ke liye jo terms bani thin woh rigid body par bhi lagti hain. Aage hum rigid body ki jagah us ki reference line OP hi lenge.

blocks.alt: Amoodi axis, jis ke oopar mura teer gardish dikhata hai. Lamba gulabi sakht jism (rigid body) axis par nuqte O se ek taraf nikla hua hai; us ke andar dashed lakeer r, O se nuqte P tak. Bara bayzawi daira woh rasta hai jis par P chalta hai, aur us par teer gardish ki simt batata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.4: Axis ke gird ghoomta sakht jism; P se axis par amood OP reference line hai (kitab ki Figure 3.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Angular aur linear velocity ka taalluq
Ek rigid body lein jo z-axis ke gird angular velocity ω se ghoom rahi hai (Fig. 3.5a).

blocks.alt: Amoodi z-axis, oopar ke qareeb mura teer jis par ω likha hai. Gulabi sakht jism axis par O se nikla hai, us ke andar dashed lakeer r, O se nuqte P tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.5(a): z-axis ke gird angular velocity ω se ghoomta sakht jism (kitab ki Figure 3.5(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Jism mein axis se perpendicular faasle r par ek nuqta P sochein; OP reference line hai. Jism ghoomta hai to P radius r ke daire par linear velocity v se chalta hai aur OP angular velocity ω se ghoomti hai (Fig. 3.5b). Hum ω aur v ka taalluq nikalna chahte hain. Axis fixed hai, is liye ω ki direction hamesha ek hi rehti hai aur ω ko scalar ki tarah le sakte hain. P ki linear velocity ki bhi sirf miqdar lenge, jo scalar hai.

blocks.alt: Ufuqi daira bayzawi shakal mein, markaz O; y-axis daen, x-axis dekhne wale ki taraf aur z-axis oopar, jis par mota neela teer ω hai. O se radius daire ke agle hisse par P₁ aur P₂ tak jate hain; OP₁ x-axis se zawiya θ banata hai, OP₁ aur OP₂ ke darmiyan chhota zawiya Δθ hai, aur qaus par P₁ se P₂ tak teer par ΔS likha hai. OP₁ par r likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.5(b): Jab OP Δθ ghoomta hai to nuqta P qaus P₁P₂ = ΔS tay karta hai (kitab ki Figure 3.5(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: ω ka teer z-axis par upar hai kyunke upar se dekhne par jism anticlockwise ghoom raha hai (right hand rule). Chhote waqt Δt mein OP angle Δθ ghoomti hai aur P arc ΔS chalta hai: ΔS = rΔθ. Axis se jitna door nuqta, utni zyada us ki linear speed.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Farz karein waqt Δt mein P faasla P₁P₂ = ΔS tay karta hai aur isi dauran OP angular displacement Δθ radian tay karti hai. Eq. 3.1 se:

blocks.alt: Zameen par radius r ke pahiye ki do haalatein. Pehli mein nuqta A zameen ko chhoo raha hai aur B kinare par oopar ki taraf hai; mura teer dikhata hai ke pahiya daen ludhakte hue clockwise ghoomta hai. Doosri mein pahiya zawiya θ ghoom chuka hai: ab B zameen ko chhoota hai aur A oopar kinare par hai. Kinare ki qaus AB aur zameen ka utna hissa nishan zada hain, aur do chhoone ke nuqton ka faasla S = r θ hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 57): jab pahiya zawiya θ ghoomta hai to zameen par tangential faasla S = r θ tay karta hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Pahiya phisle baghair ludhakta hai, is liye kinare ka jitna arc AB zameen ko chhoota hai, pahiya utna hi aage barhta hai. Arc ki lambai rθ hai (θ radian mein), is liye pahiya S = rθ aage jata hai. Yahi Eq. 3.1 hai.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Dono taraf Δt se divide karein:
Jab Δt → 0 ho to ΔS/Δt nuqta P ki speed v hai jis se woh daire par chal raha hai, aur Δθ/Δt reference line OP ki angular velocity ω hai. Is liye Eq. 3.6 yeh ban jati hai:

Fig. 3.5(b) mein P arc P₁P₂ par chal raha hai. Jab Δt → 0 ho to arc P₁P₂ bohat chhota ho jata hai aur us ki direction nuqta P₁ par daire ki tangent (mamas) ki direction hoti hai. Yani P ki velocity ki miqdar v hai aur direction hamesha us nuqte par tangent ke saath hai. Isi liye P ki linear velocity ko tangential velocity bhi kehte hain.
Isi tarah agar OP angular acceleration α se ghoome to P ka linear (tangential) acceleration aₜ hota hai. Eq. 3.7 se yeh taalluq nikalta hai:

Eq. 3.7 aur 3.8 batati hain ke ghoomte jism par axis se mukhtalif faaslon wale nuqton ki speed aur acceleration alag alag hoti hai, magar fixed axis par ghoomti rigid body ke sab nuqton ki angular displacement, angular speed aur angular acceleration har waqt ek jaisi hoti hai. Is liye angular quantities se poore jism ki harkat aasani se bayan ho jati hai.
Amusement park mein roller coaster ki chotti (top) par aap dar to sakte hain, magar ulta (upside down) hone par bhi neeche nahi girte. Kyun?
blocks.title: Point to Ponder (Sochiye)

blocks.text: Chotti par aap ka wazan (aur seat ka zor) centripetal force ka kaam karta hai jo aap ko daire mein rakhta hai. Agar speed itni ho ke v²/r ≥ g, to zaroori centripetal force wazan se zyada ya barabar hai, aur aap seat se nahi hat-te; is liye neeche nahi girte.
blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein

blocks.text: Angular motion ki equations

Angular motion ki equations (3.2, 3.3, 3.4 aur 3.5) bilkul linear motion ki equations jaisi hain; bas θ, ω aur α ki jagah S, v aur a rakh dein. Linear motion ki baqi equations inhi se algebra ke zariye nikli thin, is liye angular motion ki bhi waisi hi equations hain. Neeche angular equations aur un ki linear jori (counterparts) di gayi hain:
Equations 3.9 se 3.11 sirf tab sahi hain jab gardish ka axis fixed ho, taake sab angular vectors ki direction ek ho aur unhen scalars ki tarah istemal kiya ja sake.

blocks.title: Example 3.1
blocks.problem: Bijli ka pankha 3 rev s⁻¹ se ghoom raha hai. Band karne par woh 18.0 s mein ruk jata hai. Deceleration (raftar ka kam hona) yaksan maan kar us ki qeemat nikalein. Rukne se pehle pankhe ne kitne chakkar (revolutions) lagaye?
steps: Diya gaya: ωᵢ = 3.0 rev s⁻¹, ω_f = 0 (ruk gaya), t = 18.0 s; α = ?, θ = ?
Eq. 3.9 (ω_f = ωᵢ + αt) se: α = (ω_f − ωᵢ)/t = (0 − 3.0) rev s⁻¹ / 18.0 s = −0.167 rev s⁻² (minus ka matlab raftar kam ho rahi hai)
blocks.answer: α = −0.167 rev s⁻², aur pankha rukne se pehle 27 chakkar lagata hai.

blocks.prompt: 108 km h⁻¹ se chalti car ke pahiye ka diameter 60 cm hai; pahiye ki angular speed rad s⁻¹ aur rev s⁻¹ mein nikalein. Phir: 1800 rev min⁻¹ par chalti motor band ki jati hai aur 20 s mein yaksan taur par ruk jati hai; woh kitne chakkar lagati hai?
blocks.explanation: v = 108 km h⁻¹ = 30 m s⁻¹ aur r = 0.30 m, to ω = v/r = 100 rad s⁻¹ = 100/(2π) ≈ 16 rev s⁻¹. Motor: ωᵢ = 1800 rev min⁻¹ = 30 rev s⁻¹, ω_f = 0, t = 20 s, to α = −30/20 = −1.5 rev s⁻², aur θ = 30 × 20 + ½(−1.5)(20)² = 600 − 300 = 300 rev.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: 1 rad: arc = radius. θ = S/r, S = rθ; 1 rev = 2π rad = 360°, 1 rad = 57.3°.
Angular displacement Δθ (chhoti ho to vector), counter clockwise positive, direction right hand rule se axis ke saath.
ω = Δθ/Δt (rad s⁻¹ ya rpm); α = Δω/Δt (rad s⁻²); v = rω, aₜ = rα; linear velocity tangent ke saath.
Fixed axis ke liye: ω_f = ωᵢ + αt; 2αθ = ω_f² − ωᵢ²; θ = ωᵢt + ½αt². Example 3.1: −0.167 rev s⁻², 27 rev.
